methodology: Claimant statement vs physical occurrence vs carrier/source publication clocks separately tracked. Novel source instances do not automatically create new unique propositions, events, WOL incidents, or awards. Edges are evidence-backed referral proposals only; WOL adjudicates its own native incidents. Do not treat independent reporting of an actor's statement as independent confirmation of the claimed effects. UNSUBSTANTIATED is not FALSE, and FALSE is not knowing deception. Corrections require documented knowledge and version paths.
